note: damage after element relation and jitter. critRoll/jitterRoll/debuffRoll are the scripted randomPercent(label) values (bound 100, so 99 never crits and 0 always does). The engine only nudges damage by one when (damage * 2) / 100 is zero, so at or above 50 damage the jitter roll changes nothing. critThreshold sweeps that roll across the engine's own crit chance on one fixed pair, so the chance is measured instead of assumed.
